in_english.name: Dakhiratun
in_english.long_meaning: Dakhiratun: Derived from the Arabic root 'D-K-H-R', meaning 'great' or 'first'. In Arabic, it is one of the lofty names signifying truthfulness and sincerity. In the Quran, it is used to describe those who are blessed with tranquility and peace (Surah Al-An'am, 6:120). This name is a powerful choice for a child, symbolizing the values of faith, trustworthiness, and steadfastness.
